premise: A newly married couple navigates their first days together while the wife conceals her complete inability to cook with the secret help of her mother.
running_bits: Amrutha's mother secretly packing and supplying pre-made food varieties into tiffin boxes
Husband romanticizing simple everyday routines into grand emotional philosophies (tea therapy, send-off hugs)
Amrutha's blunder explanations of cooking ingredients (wheat flour instead of gram flour in mirchi bajji)
Groom comparing every aspect of marital life and romance to elements of full meals
catchphrases: It's a emotion, it's a therapy
Good food a day makes my day good day
relationships: Husband and Amrutha: Newly wed couple getting to know each other
Father-in-law and Husband: Father who raised him alone and took over domestic duties
Mother and Amrutha: Mother secretly coaching and bailing out her non-cooking daughter
Amrutha and Groom: Prospective bride and groom getting arranged-married
Amrutha and Mother: Mother frantically covering up daughter's complete inability to cook
